Additionally, the API handler first deletes all comment memos (each recursing through the above) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-577`.

**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the in-repo filter engine at `internal/filter/` (`engine.go:23` `Engine`, `DefaultEngine`; schema in `schema.go`, parser `parser.go`, IR `ir.go`, renderer `render.go`). Mechanism: the handler passes `request.Filter` into `store.FindMemo.Filters` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:215`); each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` + `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect*, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`), which compiles CEL → dialect-agnostic IR → a dialect-specific SQL fragment + placeholder args appended to the WHERE clause (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9-25`, `internal/filter/render.go`).

**q26.**
```
memo            (the memo row plus comment memo rows — store/memo.go:158, server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:573-577)
memo_relation   (both directions — store/memo.go:142,145)
attachment      (attachments linked to the memo — store/memo.go:149-157)
memo_share      (only via FK ON DELETE CASCADE in the schema — store/migration/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}/LATEST.sql:~108; note SQLite opens with _pragma=foreign_keys(0), store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53, so the cascade is not enforced there)
```
`reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but not deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545`).

**q27.** Mechanism: Go `embed.FS` of the built `dist/` bundle served by Echo's static middleware with SPA fallback to `index.html`. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (`//go:embed dist/*`) and `:41-80` (`FrontendService.Serve`), invoked from `server/server.go:72`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go) — one RunOnce at startup, then a 12-hour time.Ticker (runner.go:26-40); started in server/server.go:156-171
```
Unused-infra note: `internal/scheduler/` (cron-style scheduler with `scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`, `middleware.go`) is referenced only by its own tests/examples — nothing in `server/` or `cmd/` imports it. Also `server/runner/memopayload` is not a scheduled runner; it's called inline from the memo handlers (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**q29.**
```
interceptor path — web/src/connect.ts:156 (authInterceptor, installed on the transport at :188)
token kinds — short-lived JWT access token (Bearer header; persisted in localStorage via web/src/auth-state.ts) and a long-lived refresh token in the httpOnly cookie "memos_refresh" (credentials: "include", refreshed via AuthService.RefreshToken); backend also accepts personal access tokens (memos_pat_ prefix)
backend package — server/auth (server/auth/authenticator.go, server/auth/token.go), driven by the Authorizer used in both the gateway middleware and Connect NewAuthInterceptor (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:68,138)
```

**q30.**
```
memo created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:16 (called memo_service.go:155)
memo updated: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:21 (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)
memo deleted: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:26 (called memo_service.go:562)
memo comment created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:31 (called memo_service_comments.go:120)
```
The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:102`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120`.
